svg.text: Scheduling is derived from the declared dependency graph.
The eight Layer 1 and Layer 2 pins hold no mutual
dependency and execute concurrently; D1, D2, E1 and F1
start the moment their own inputs are satisfied. A failed
pin degrades the evidence set; it does not halt the pipeline.
